title: Which EBS volume type?
claim: Large sequential data fits an HDD type, and other workloads start on gp3 unless they need io2 Block Express.
alt: A decision ladder with three questions. Large sequential data that is scanned rarely leads to sc1; large sequential data that is scanned often leads to st1; a need beyond gp3 leads to io2 Block Express; everything else leads to gp3.
